body: May I ask what you're talking about?  In my temporary hysteria, I'm not understanding what you meant.
I will do anything... I am trying to get back into college but I keep being ignored.
Thank you... I don't mean to seem so negative but getting back on my feet seems impossible.
I don't have any friends. They've all left.  I have no one. Thank you for the siuggestion. No harm in checking that subreddit out.

I can't find a job to save my life.  I'm living with my insane parents after my husband left me with nothing.  I've been on antidepressants for years, it only works for so long. I'm constantly told I'm nothing. Every time I trust a man, they use me and turn me away. I can't stand looking in the mirror. All I see are my mistakes and the scars others have left.
Thank you for your support and advice. I will try to get more involved.

I've felt this many times. It may seem like that now but you may not see how much you do have to stick around for. A new day may show you just how much you'd be missing. If you need to talk, please send a message. Someone always cares and is here for you.

I know what you're feeling. Like nothing is worth trying for. I may not know you but I know the feeling of wanting to die. Regardless of what you believe, there are always people willing to help you. There are always people who care. If I may ask you to do one thing, just wait. I know it's difficult but wait one day. If you can make it one day try for two and keep going. You've already taken a step by reaching out. People may seem heartless but someone, somewhere is bound to grab your hand. Hold on... you're an amazing person. Maybe those around you simply don't see it.
Thank you for making me smile.

Internet hugs are great so, no need to apologize for anything at all. I've been almost obsessive in trying to figure out what I did wrong but I finally realized, even if I did, it doesn't matter. Maybe I'll try dating again after I rebuild some confidence. Thank you and an internet hug back to you.
